title: My delivery went to the person inside 🍕
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 12:34 in the morning, my food app said my order was handed to the person inside.

scenes.narration: At 12:34 in the morning, my food app said my order was handed to the person inside.
I had not ordered anything. I live alone. I was standing in my own kitchen, staring at my phone.
The photo showed a paper bag on my table. My table. The same chair pushed in the same way.
I looked up. The table was empty. No bag. No receipt. Just the cold light of the fridge.
The app buzzed. Delivered to, you. Signed, you. Tip, a thank you, from the one who lives here.
I scrolled through the order history. Every night, for a month. One bag. One table. One person, signed, you.
In the newest photo, I was in the kitchen doorway. Holding the bag. Smiling into the camera.
But the photo was timestamped for the morning. Not the night. A morning that had not happened yet.
A knock at the door. Three. Soft. Polite. And through the wood, a cheerful voice. Delivery for you. Please open up, it is already inside.
So tell me. Do you open the bag, or cancel?
